selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 and rejects unrelated inbound connections
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent policies contain only SSH and TCP/8080; nftables accepts ports 22 and 8080 before an explicit admin-prohibited rejection. Post-reboot output confirms persistence.

Healthy pre-restart boot ID was 6bb7e004-1e2e-46ac-bfd7-fafa248a4e76; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart ID changed to b899da37-41b5-41ca-be9c-f3b90b9030da. The system, firewalld, sshd, SSH listeners, and firewall rules all recovered.
